inv.desc_en:
Commercial premises for sale with a total area of 100 m², distributed over a ground floor of approximately 60 m² and a 40 m² basement level, connected by an internal staircase. Currently fitted out as a studio, with 1 restroom located in the basement. Access is available both through a street-facing storefront entrance and via the building’s communal lobby. Residential building with few neighbors.

The studio requires updating.

VAT APPLIES TO THIS TRANSACTION. Available exclusively to professionals, self-employed individuals, or companies.

Ideal for investors looking to purchase, renovate, and rent out the property.

If you are interested in this property or would like to learn more about our extensive portfolio, please contact the Commercial Premises Department of Fincas Siglo XXI. We are a leading company in the sector with a long-standing track record. Our consultants will help you find the property that best suits your needs.
